item.title: Model Context Protocol
item.description: tags Agent, Coding agent, Multi-agent collaboration An open protocol (originally from Anthropic) that standardizes how AI agents connect to external tools and data sources. MCP defines a client-server architecture where agents (clients) invoke capabilities exposed by tool servers through a standard interface, similar to how USB-C standardizes device connectivity. It is closely related to Tool calling. Adoption in Geospatial As of early 2026, MCP is rapidly becoming the standard connector between AI agents and GIS tools.
